exercise.title: Skip a string, faster stages
exercise.why: Skipping a string makes the pick travel twice as far between notes, so a faster tempo shows whether your hand aims the jump or your eyes do.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome. Pick down, up on each string, then jump over the next string, as the tab shows.
When the pick lands on the right string without you looking, try a faster stage. Use the Stage selector below to change the tempo, then press Play to start the metronome again.
If you have to watch your picking hand to make the jump, stay on a slower stage until you don't.
